text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Bosnia's biggest paper factory "Natron" in Maglaj started 10 per cent of its pre-war production but needs 17 million German Marks for complete production revival, factory's director Salim Ibrahimefendic says.

- Consumer's basket with 40 products for a four-member family in Moslem-Croat federation costs 334 German Marks while an average salary of workers in production is 170 DEM and non- production salary 293 DEM, Bosnia's statistics bureau said.
- There are 133,177 unemployed people in Moslem-Croat federation, of those 41,157 are demobilised soldiers, the Statistics bureau said.
- U.S. computer company "Dell" installs 30 computers in Sarajevo on Monday for training of 900 Bosnian experts under a World Bank project.
